evidence.reason: Line 856 only inspects `.wants` and `.requires` directories. On systemd v257, `.upholds` directories are also read as dependency links, so a foreign link such as `ingress.target.upholds/crq-tick.service` can make the target restart the crq unit while escaping the undeclared-link check. This is an implementation gap in the existing foreign-enablement verification, not merely a new hardening request.
